subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Its emotional and relational benefits are clear.
Its emosional and relational benefits are clear.
Its emotional and relationel benefits are clear.
Its emotional and relational benifits are clear.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"emotional"** means relating to a person's emotions or feelings. (भावनात्मक)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave an **emotional** speech that moved everyone to tears.
 
 
 
• **"Relational"** refers to the way in which two or more people or things are connected. (संबंधित)
 
 
• **Example:** The **relational **dynamics within the team were crucial for its success.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Emosional** (भावनात्मक): This is a misspelling of "emotional."

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling, no valid example.
 
 
 
• **Relationel** (संबंधित): This is a misspelling of "relational."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling, no valid example.
 
 
 
• **Benifits** (लाभ): This is a misspelling of "benefits."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect spelling, no valid example.
